FN-TBRHT15-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 171
Committee: Children and Senior Advocacy Sponsor: Representative Ben Robbins
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 01/19/2026
House Bill 171 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Attorney General by an
undetermined amount to investigate violations against social media platforms and operators that
host addictive feeds without age verification or parental consent, which could be offset by civil
penalties imposed not exceeding $5,000 per violation.
